summary: Completed comprehensive testing of horse racing betting analyzer (NO AUTH MODE) - all core functionality working perfectly

design_issues.issue: Secondary pages (Statistics, Bet History, Settings) not loading content properly

/api/bankroll PUT endpoint updates bankroll settings successfully

/api/analyze endpoint with track=wolverhampton, race_number=1 returns horse recommendations (11 horses analyzed)
/api/bets GET endpoint returns empty bets list initially (0 bets as expected)
/api/bets POST endpoint creates new bet successfully
/api/bets/{bet_id}/settle endpoint settles bet as WIN with profit calculation
/api/statistics endpoint returns statistics (1 bet, 100% win rate, 351% ROI)
Frontend dashboard loads at /dashboard with user welcome message
Frontend dashboard displays bankroll widget with real-time data
Frontend dashboard shows quick stats (Win Rate, Total Bets, ROI, Total Profit)

Frontend dashboard shows 8-criteria algorithm information

Dropdown selectors show tracks from API (wolverhampton selectable)
Race number dropdown shows races 1-10
Analysis button triggers race analysis and shows results
Race analysis displays betting recommendations (WIN, PLACE, TRIFECTA, SAFETY)
8-criteria scoring algorithm displays detailed breakdown
All Horses Analysis section with Score Overview and Detailed Breakdown tabs
Place Bet buttons open confirmation dialogs

Navigation between Dashboard and Race Analysis working
